summary_scope: 15 canonical model-dataset cells x two answer sides at fixed alpha=4

direction_and_effect.direction: MD direction; unit-normalized in every source artifact
direction_and_effect.effect_unit: each seed: mean over its 200 paired P(Yes)_intervention - P(Yes)_baseline values
direction_and_effect.random_observation: mean of the seed-level effects for a single random direction; directions, not seed-direction pairs, are null observations

test_statistic.both_sides: T = abs(Delta P); exceedance is abs(Delta P_random) >= abs(Delta P_MD)
test_statistic.summary_null_columns: null_* are summaries of abs(Delta P_random); md_delta_p remains the signed effect

bh.family: the 30 model-dataset-side directional tests in c4_random_direction_summary.csv
bh.note: source studies used separate pre-existing decisions (often per-dataset Bonferroni); q_bh is the harmonized appendix calculation.

specificity.interpretation: Twenty-nine of 30 tests had zero random-direction exceedances. The sole nonzero case is Mistral-7B / TriviaQA / false: one opposite-sign random direction (R087, Delta P=-0.4452250116967966) exceeded the prompt-matched MD magnitude (0.41918701528396074). It remains BH-significant in the 30-test family.
specificity.prompt_matched_mistral_note: The C3 fixed-dose Mistral TriviaQA row is a legacy no-system-prompt result (Delta P_false=0.4726971543506121). The random-null source uses an explicit system prompt, so C4's valid paired null comparison uses its source-matched MD effect 0.41918701528396074 and baseline; mixing the legacy MD value with this null would not be a matched Monte-Carlo test.

null_magnitude_diagnostics.rows: 18 rows: 3 7B models x 3 datasets x false/true side
null_magnitude_diagnostics.null_magnitude_formula: median over 127 directions of abs(direction-level seed-mean paired Delta P)

regression.model: ordinary least squares: log(null_magnitude) = intercept + slope * log(predictor_value)

null_magnitude_diagnostics.reported_1p01_pm_0p21_r2_0p60: This is the rounded OLS slope +/- slope standard error and R^2 for the stated 18-row log--log regression; the precise recomputed values are recorded above.

norm_matched_random_control.scope: TriviaQA; Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen2.5-7B, Mistral-7B, and Qwen2.5-14B; two sides each
norm_matched_random_control.target: r approximately .05 (Qwen-7B is fixed alpha=4, achieved r=0.051186208715835256)
